name: Randomized Littlestone Dimension of Full Cube
proof: The cube has a complete shattered tree of depth n, so its randomized value is at least n/2. Conversely, any shattered tree has at most $2^n$ leaves, and a random branch reaches a leaf with probability $2^{-d}$ at each leaf of depth d; its expected length is the entropy of this dyadic leaf distribution and is at most $\log_2(2^n)=n$. Thus the value is exactly n/2.
